headline: Morning junk, evening cleans as it eases.
today: Morning's cross-on and choppy on a short-period S with some size. It tidies up in the afternoon as the E goes cross-off, and evening NNE offshore is the cleanest stretch, though the swell's dropping by then. Fish or groveler if you time the back half of the day.

daysToWatch.note: Clean 3ft with light NW morning winds — best conditions of the week here.
SE good angle with longer period and light dawn — worth a dawn check.
